gates.evidence: The proposal operates on the Services Tab and Create Account flow, which are standard SFW components of Luzia.
The reward is a 30-minute time-boxed trial of premium features, which is an in-app service, not cash or a gift.
The offer is an additional 'Not ready yet?' prompt and does not threaten content loss or use confirmshaming.
The storyboard shows an invite overlay requiring a 'Play to try' tap to initiate the ad.
The card body explicitly states: 'Play a 15-second game to try 30 minutes of Upgrade to Luzia+ now.'
The offer object defines a title, body, and cta, but 'decline' is left as an empty string.
The trigger is specifically after the Create Account Sheet is dismissed on the Services Tab.
The proposal explicitly gates eligibility to 'Guests who just declined the account sheet' and 'never payers or subscribers'.

scores.evidence: The reward is a sample of the exact feature the user just declined (Create Account/Luzia+), perfectly matching the user's need for the premium functionality.
The ad does not interrupt the core chat loop and uses a native chip on the Services Tab.
It is gated to guests only, capped at once per day, and provides a 30-minute trial sample which is highly unlikely to cannibalize a full subscription.
COGS is zero, and the revenue per view is positive; it serves as a low-cost trial conversion lever.
m1/m2 are frequent moments in the product model, ensuring good reach among non-paying users.
Maps to SIM-RWD via a native card on the Services Tab.
Uses Luzia-specific elements (Services Tab, Create Account Sheet, Luzia+).
Capped at once per day, though it lacks an explicit cooldown cooldownMin.
Includes a holdout, guardrails, and success metrics.

requiredChanges: Add a visible 'No thanks' decline button to the offer object.
Specify a cooldownMin (e.g., 60 minutes) to further protect the UX.
parsed.topConcern: The proposal lacks an explicit decline option in the offer object, which is a violation of the 'Declining is free' policy.
